# notion

Drives the Notion API through the ntn command line tool: read and search content, create pages, query databases, upload files, and deploy workers. Also publishes an explanation of a diff, branch, or pull request as a native Notion page.

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`explain-diff-notion`](skills/explain-diff-notion/README.md) | Use when the user asks for a rich explanation of a code change, diff, branch, or PR. Produces a Notion page. |
| [`notion-cli`](skills/notion-cli/README.md) | Use the Notion CLI (`ntn`) to interact with the Notion API, manage workers, and upload files. Use when the user asks to "call the Notion API", "deploy a worker", "upload a file to Notion", "create a page", "query a database", or read or search Notion content, or any task involving the `ntn` command. |

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install notion@Uraxii
```

Codex CLI:

```
codex plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai --ref main
codex plugin add notion@uraxii
```

Copilot CLI:

```
copilot plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
copilot plugin install notion@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
